skills.name: gmf-contribute
skills.summary: Add an operation, knowledge note, template or test to GMF without breaking the catalog contract.

skills.name: gmf-debug
skills.summary: Diagnose a failed build, deploy or validation from the exact command, exit code and log tail.

skills.name: gmf-implement
skills.summary: Implement and deploy mod code for an approved plan, one step at a time.

skills.name: gmf-investigate
skills.summary: Investigate a game folder and produce an evidence-backed profile before any mod work.

skills.name: gmf-plan
skills.summary: Draft, review and validate a plan whose steps, effects and gates match the user's goal.

skills.name: gmf-release
skills.summary: Package a finished mod locally and verify its contents and license before release.

skills.name: gmf-safety
skills.summary: Use backups, authorizations and anti-cheat risk information correctly before writing into a game.

skills.name: gmf-verify
skills.summary: Verify each plan step with evidence and report pass, fail and unresolved unknowns.

skills.name: unity-assets
skills.summary: Use when a Unity mod must extract, inspect, replace or load assets such as textures, models, audio or AssetBundles.

skills.name: unity-bepinex
skills.summary: Use when a Unity game runs BepInEx 5 or 6 and you must scaffold, build, deploy, validate or package a plugin for it.

skills.name: unity-harmony
skills.summary: Use when you must patch a Unity game method with Harmony, reach private members by reflection, or confirm a patch target still exists.

skills.name: unity-il2cpp
skills.summary: Use when the Unity game is IL2CPP and a mod needs interop assemblies, Il2CppInterop patching, or IL2CPP-safe C# patterns.

skills.name: unity-melonloader
skills.summary: Use when a Unity game runs MelonLoader and you must scaffold, build, deploy, validate or package a Melon mod for it.

skills.name: unity-testing
skills.summary: Use when a Unity mod needs unit tests, a CI build without game assemblies, or a failure must be debugged from logs and profiling.

skills.name: unity-translation
skills.summary: Use when a Unity game's text must be translated or localized by a mod, including font fallback for other scripts.

skills.name: unreal-aob
skills.summary: Use when a UE4SS or PatternSleuth scan fails and a byte-pattern signature must be analyzed, emitted and verified by hand.

skills.name: unreal-cookbook
skills.summary: Use when writing a concrete UE4SS Lua feature such as noclip, god mode, currency, item spawning, or a mod menu from a proven pattern.

skills.name: unreal-debugging
skills.summary: Use when a UE4SS mod does not load, a hook does not fire, the game crashes with UE4SS attached, or a log or crash stack needs reading.

skills.name: unreal-dumping
skills.summary: Use when a mod needs game-derived data first, such as an object dump, usmap, header dump or static mesh dump.

skills.name: unreal-object-model
skills.summary: Use when you must reason about UObject, UClass, UFunction, FName and properties, or locate a target in an object dump.

skills.name: unreal-pak-blueprint
skills.summary: Use when an Unreal task needs pak or IoStore containers, an extracted or edited asset packed as a mod, or a Blueprint mod mounted through the LogicMods folder.

skills.name: unreal-reference-patterns
skills.summary: Use when planning a UE4SS Lua feature and you need a proven pattern, a field note or a mined gotcha instead of guessing.

skills.name: unreal-ue4ss-cpp
skills.summary: Use when writing or building a native C++ mod against the UE4SS SDK for an Unreal Engine game.

skills.name: unreal-ue4ss-lua
skills.summary: Use when writing, hooking, installing or deploying a UE4SS Lua mod for an Unreal Engine game.
